name: Lithium-Ion Battery Failure Intelligence
description: An evidence-backed specialist system covering lithium-ion cell and system failure: failure mechanisms, thermal runaway initiation and propagation, vent-gas composition, early detection, suppression and cooling, battery energy storage and electric-vehicle incident precedent, and the transport, storage, installation and waste rules that govern them. Every answer is traceable to a stored source with a URI, publisher and retrieval date, and is machine-checked for unsupported claims before it is returned.

name: Industrial Fire & Explosion Intelligence
description: An evidence-backed specialist system covering industrial fire and explosion hazards: flammable atmospheres, dust explosions, vapour cloud explosions, BLEVEs, ignition sources and control, hazardous area classification, and the UK and EU regimes that govern dangerous substances and major accident hazards. Answers are traceable to stored sources and are machine-checked for unsupported claims before they are returned.
